Image 1 is ONLY the chosen Steel / Sky visual style reference: its six tiles demonstrate a style, not your output layout. Rebuild just the requested individual slide at full size.
STYLE LOCK: #355872 dark steel for text/lines; #7AAACE secondary blue; #9CD5FF sky accents; #F7F8F0 ivory background. Flat clean colors, no extra accent colors. Actual inserted photographs retain natural colors. Match the reference's strong oversized Korean sans-serif headings, thin open diagrams, generous negative space, restrained square corner motifs. Use one consistent Noto Sans KR-like sans family, bold headline around 58px, main text 32-38px at 2048 width, captions at least 23px. Main content left/right margins 110px, heading baseline near y180. One headline and one dominant composition. Slide number small top left. No random English decor, slogans, logos, middle-dot separators, neon, glossy cards, shadows, repetitive rounded cards or stock robot renders. Use commas or slashes.
CONTENT LOCK: render supplied Korean text accurately and keep all numbers/units. Do not add empirical facts, percentages, rankings or unprovided claims. A concept drawing must be labeled 개념도. Do not conflate implemented features with validated mission success. Real image inputs are supporting inserts: preserve their robot pose, actual blocks, colors and boundaries, do not reimagine or synthesize their content. Crop only for readability, retaining the evidence context. No fabricated experimental scenes.
Only the explicitly listed on-screen text should appear. Presenter notes are not to be printed. Use readable large labels, not dense report paragraphs. Produce a clean full-bleed slide.
